claim: A run's observed internal event-transition context predicts its next event on unseen refinement levels better than external metadata and position-only baselines, and that advantage degrades when transition structure is destroyed.
competing_explanations: probe and hierarchy metadata alone determine event order
event position alone determines the next event
transition advantage survives arbitrary order destruction

controls.name: transition_shuffled_training
controls.preserved: run count, event labels, probes, hierarchy labels, split membership

controls.name: context_ablation
controls.preserved: trained counts, targets, candidate labels, run metadata

failure_threshold: Any required source inconsistency or control mechanism failure returns INSTRUMENT_INVALID. Valid execution that misses any official success gate returns NEGATIVE_RESULT.
invalidation_conditions: duplicate run keys with conflicting chain signatures
chain signature disagrees with event ranks
holdout level appears in model construction
future event is included in the predictor key
control does not change the declared transition mechanism
non_claims: not organizational closure in a biological sense
not a physical law or physical bridge

seed_policy.unit_of_uncertainty: independent stored run key; bootstrap resamples are uncertainty only

stopping_condition: Classify after one execution under the frozen split and controls. Do not tune predictor keys or thresholds after observing the result.
